description:
Record it, and know who said what.

Transcription Studio turns a recording, a meeting, a file or a link into a transcript that is split by speaker — and the models that do it run on your Mac.

ON YOUR MAC, NOT A SERVER
Speech recognition and speaker separation happen here. No audio is sent to a transcription service, because there is no such service in the pipeline. The speech model downloads once, about 1.6 GB, and after that a transcript needs no connection at all.

MEETING CAPTURE
Record the system audio of a call straight off the Mac — both sides of the conversation, split by speaker, with no bot joining the meeting and nothing routed through a server.

PASTE A LINK
Give it a media link and the Mac pulls the audio down and transcribes it locally. An iPhone signed into the same account can hand its links to your Mac and get the finished transcript back.

WHO SAID WHAT
Speakers are separated automatically and stay straight for the length of the session, so a two-hour interview reads as a conversation instead of a wall of text.

WHAT YOU GET BACK
• A transcript you can search, edit and export as text, Markdown, SRT, VTT or Word
• Decisions and action items pulled out of the conversation for you to confirm
• A calendar event or a reminder written from what was said, after you review it
• A question answered out of everything you have ever recorded
• Any session locked behind Touch ID or your Mac password
• A transcript read back to you in a voice synthesized on the device
• Drag a file onto the window, or share a link to it from Safari
• Siri and Shortcuts for the whole surface: record, transcribe, search, summarize, export

EVERY DEVICE YOU OWN
Mac, iPhone and iPad. Transcription Studio requires a free FCT account: your sessions, transcripts and recordings live in that account, so a new device rebuilds the whole library — every word of every transcript — without downloading a single recording.

PRIVACY
Where the work happens and where the result is kept are two different claims, and they stay separate here. The models run on your Mac. The library is stored in your FCT account, scoped to you and readable by no other account. No ads, no third-party analytics or tracking SDKs, no advertising identifier; anonymous diagnostics key on a random install identifier joined to no account. Delete a session, this app's data or the whole account from Settings.

Summaries, highlights and library questions use Apple Intelligence and need a Mac that supports it; a transcript past the on-device window uses Apple's Private Cloud Compute.

Available in ten languages. Requires macOS 27.
promotionalText: Every model runs on your device: the words, the speakers, and the voice that reads them back. Your library lives in your own FCT account — never ours to read.
